anomalies.description: A handgun is fired, producing a visible muzzle flash and smoke; the man in the blue shirt is struck in the chest and recoils.
A man in a green shirt points a handgun directly at a woman running away; the gun is held in a firing stance with arm extended, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting.
A man in a green shirt and a woman in pink pajamas engage in mutual physical combat in a kitchen area, involving grabbing, pushing, and use of a chair as a weapon or shield.

A woman in a yellow top stabs another woman in the abdomen with a knife; the victim is standing still and appears helpless during the attack, with blood visible on the blade and later on the victim's face and neck.

After being stabbed, the victim reacts aggressively—screaming, leaning in, and engaging face-to-face with the attacker; both are actively confronting each other, suggesting mutual physical escalation despite prior one-sided attack.

A woman with severe facial blood injuries is being confronted and yelled at by another woman; the injured woman appears passive and helpless while the other woman is aggressive and vocal, with a man observing in the background. No physical contact is visible, but the sustained aggressive posture and victim's condition indicate abuse.
The bloodied woman lunges and grabs the man's shoulder/upper arm with her right hand, appearing to attack or restrain him; he recoils in shock and pain.
